summary: La Rosa Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K/A to correct and amend its prior 8-K regarding a Securities Purchase Agreement for the issuance of 250 shares of Series E Convertible Preferred Stock at $1,000 per share, raising $250,000 in gross proceeds. The amendment corrects the report date and specifies the filing date of the Certificate of Designation. This is a routine equity financing for working capital, not a special situation. There is no change of control, tender, or strategic action. Watch for future dilution from conversion of the preferred stock.
